v86.wash_st: Have you recorded the wash-sale loss adjustment amount (a loss disallowed because you bought the same investment within 30 days before or after the sale) of every covered short-term sale on every Form 1099-B you or your spouse received for 2025?
v86.wash_lt: Have you recorded the wash-sale loss adjustment amount (a loss disallowed because you bought the same investment within 30 days before or after the sale) of every covered long-term sale on every Form 1099-B you or your spouse received for 2025?
v86.only_box2a: Is it true that you had no capital gains in 2025 other than capital gain distributions in box 2a of Form 1099-DIV (for example, no gain from selling stock, funds or other property)?
v86.sli: Is someone else claiming you as a dependent on their 2025 return?

v87.wash_st: Have you recorded the wash-sale loss adjustment amount of every covered short-term sale with a wash-sale loss adjustment (a loss disallowed because you bought the same investment within 30 days before or after the sale) on every Form 1099-B you or your spouse received for 2025?
v87.wash_lt: Have you recorded the wash-sale loss adjustment amount of every covered long-term sale with a wash-sale loss adjustment (a loss disallowed because you bought the same investment within 30 days before or after the sale) on every Form 1099-B you or your spouse received for 2025?
v87.only_box2a: Is it true that you had no capital gains in 2025 other than capital gain distributions in box 2a of Form 1099-DIV, and that you had no sale in 2025 of stock, bonds, funds or other property that you must report on Form 8949 or Schedule D (even one with no gain or loss)? Sales inside an IRA or 401(k) do not count, and neither does a loss on a personal item unless you received a Form 1099-S for it or you report it on Form 8949.
v87.sli: Is someone else claiming you (or your spouse, on a joint return) as a dependent on their 2025 return?
